definitions.explanation: A flat, rectangular hard- or soft-sided case used to carry documents, a laptop, and other office items. Typically associated with business attire and white-collar work.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいブリーフケースを{買|か}った。
ブリーフケースに{書類|しょるい}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I put the documents in my briefcase.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{革|かわ}のブリーフケースを{持|も}って{会社|かいしゃ}に{出|で}かける。
examples.english: Every morning my father heads off to work with his leather briefcase.

notes:
From English "briefcase." Generally pictured as a stiff, flap-style case rather than a soft bag. In modern business settings the more flexible ビジネスバッグ has largely replaced it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革|かわ}のブリーフケース: leather briefcase
- ブリーフケースを{持|も}つ: to carry a briefcase
- ブリーフケースを{開|あ}ける: to open a briefcase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鞄|かばん}: bag — general term, covers any kind of bag including briefcases
- ビジネスバッグ: business bag — softer, more contemporary office bag
- アタッシュケース: attaché case — hard-sided case, often metallic, more formal than ブリーフケース
